# AuraGlass 5.0.0-alpha.0

> React 19 component system with a layered glass material (`aura-glass`). Import components by canonical name, style them through `data-ag-part` and `data-state` attributes and the `ag` cascade layer, and add certified registry blocks with `@auraglass/cli`. This file is generated from `package.json`, the exports manifest and the component metas; version 5.0.0-alpha.0.

## Install

- `npm install aura-glass@next`
- `npx @auraglass/cli init` (writes `auraglass.json` and the `aura-glass/styles.css` import plus layer statement)
- `npx @auraglass/cli add <block>` (shadcn-format registry items)
- Upgrading from 4.x: `npx @auraglass/cli migrate 4to5 --dry-run`
- MCP server for agents: `npx @auraglass/mcp` (stdio; tools `search_components`, `get_component`, `list_registry`, `get_registry_item`, `get_migration`)

## Do not

- Do not import `Glass*` names from `aura-glass`: they are 4.x names. Use the canonical name (`Dialog`, not the 4.x modal) or the time-boxed `aura-glass/compat` adapter while migrating.
- Do not set inline optics (blur, saturation, tint, opacity) through `style`; pick a material variant or token instead.
- Do not use `!important`; AuraGlass styles live in the `ag` layer, so unlayered app CSS already wins.
- Do not target internal class names; style via `[data-ag-part="…"]` and `[data-state="…"]` selectors.
- Do not reference components removed in 5.0; `get_migration` names the replacement.

## Versions

- `5.0.0-alpha.0` — this package, published on the `next` dist-tag
- `5.x` — pre-release train on `next`; GA pending
- `4.x` — current stable on `latest` until 5.0.0 GA, then `v4-lts` (fixes and security only for 12 months after GA)
- `<4.x` — unsupported
